data.content_ref: inline:The target fails the problem's causal-mechanism demand because the proposed single-evaluation diagnostic does not isolate genuine reliability gain from a confound. If the panel overrides the planted defect and the expert fails, the target declares 'genuine reliability gain is shown,' but this outcome is consistent with the panel merely following an informal consensus heuristic that happens to track the right answer — the very 'mere compliance that happens to track the right answer' the problem asks to distinguish. The countercondition requiring articulation of the override is offered only as an observation, not wired into the claimed diagnostic inference, so the core argument still lacks a causal mechanism separating meta-cognitive override from lucky tracking.
